exRevenir.r1_t: There's very little chance your ex will come back
exRevenir.r1_d: Almost all your answers point the same way: your ex has made their decision, and nothing that has happened since shows any hesitation. It doesn't mean your relationship didn't matter. It means your ex has already moved on, and waiting could cost you a lot of time.
exRevenir.r1_a: Don't put your life on hold waiting for a text. Cut contact for a while, put away what keeps pulling you back (the photos, the old messages), and let yourself hurt without expecting anything from them.
exRevenir.r2_d: A few threads remain between you, but nothing is heading toward a comeback: your ex isn't taking any steps toward you, or something on their side is closing the door, like a new relationship or a request to stop texting. Things can change with time, but not by pushing.
exRevenir.r2_a: Respect the distance they've put between you, even if it's hard. If your ex comes back one day, it'll be because they miss you, not because you found the right message.
exRevenir.r3_d: Your situation goes both ways. Some things make a comeback possible, like feelings that are still there or contact that never stopped, and others hold it back. Nothing is decided, and what happens in the next few weeks will matter more than anything else.
exRevenir.r3_a: Don't force anything. If you want them back, say it once, clearly, then let your ex take the next step. And ask yourself the question too: would this comeback be good for you?
exRevenir.r4_t: There's a real chance your ex will come back
exRevenir.r4_d: Several things point toward a comeback: your ex keeps in touch, the breakup wasn't that clear-cut, and nobody serious has replaced you. This is often the kind of situation where couples find their way back to each other.
exRevenir.r4_a: Before doing everything to make it happen, ask yourself what would be different this time. Getting back together mostly works when what split you up has changed.
exRevenir.r5_t: Your ex already has a foot in the door
exRevenir.r5_d: Almost everything points toward a comeback: your ex talks to you, shows you they miss you, and the breakup looked more like a pause than an ending. If they haven't made the move yet, it might just be a matter of time... or of courage.
exRevenir.r5_a: Now it's mostly up to you to know whether you want it, and on what terms. Take the time to talk it through with your ex before saying yes.
